name: VinylIcon
source_reference: Existing Vinyl Widget app icon, used for product context; intentional modern redesign.
brief: A modern, restrained macOS icon for a Spotify vinyl player: a graphite record, soft mint label, and a simple silver tonearm on a pale sage field. Recognizable at Dock size.

semantic_review.basis: Original direct-authored turntable icon; the old graphic is context for a requested redesign, not an identity to reproduce.
semantic_review.notes: Retains a vinyl and green accent while intentionally changing the palette, composition, and adding a tonearm.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: An intentional redesign preserving vinyl-player meaning, not pixel matching.
acceptance_checks: record and tonearm remain recognizable at 64 pixels
